$comment: The cloud cost run's executions (COST-0, run 2026-10-03). plan.sh prices them, run.sh runs them in order (EXECUTIONS=name,name to pick). Each is one Cloud Run Job execution: `tasks` tasks of `cpu` vCPU / `memoryGiB` GiB, each running SLICES[task % length] with `parallel` tests at once in isolated lanes. expectedMinutes is per task. `ai`: needs a model (author, heal).
